items.title: What Kind of Factory Will You Build?
items.snippet: A software factory has four components: a shared context, skills & specs, an execution trace, & a curator loop that rewrites the system from the trace. Notion's A New Shape for Work & LangChain's knowledge factory describe the same loop for company knowledge. The architecture generalizes to marketing & sales factories, so the open question is what kind of factory to build.
